files.description: Primary FIFO confirmation test, seven learned configurations, 500 instances per training seed.
The higher-training-budget POMO checkpoints with greedy and 20-start decoding, plus HA-DRL, on the primary common instances.
35 workload conditions; 200 common instances in each condition.
Full policy, six input removals, and fourteen reward variants on their separate 500-instance test.
Five spatial/range/load conditions, including learned and deterministic heuristic policies.
Paired original and fine-tuned policies on 500 N=30 instances.
Known rates and three online-estimator initializations on heterogeneous arrivals.
Current fixed-window hover communication experiment, eight policies, three conditions, 500 instances per checkpoint and condition.
Selected and epoch-100 checkpoints, midpoint and conditional-uniform timestamps, on 500 separate instances.
125 evaluation-threshold combinations for three methods and five seeds, each using 500 instances.
Seven scale/load conditions with five policies and 100 instances per condition and seed.
The separate greedy and 20-start POMO decoding comparison summarized in Supplementary Section S4.
Seven recorded base/low/high reward coefficients; one coefficient changes at a time.
